declarations.description:
Mobile-friendly Reader Selection & Highlight Toolbar Component.

Designed to prevent UX conflicts with mobile/Android OS touch-to-search panels,
system gesture areas, and native copy popovers by offering 3 ergonomic modes:

1. `floating` (Draggable Floating Island): Elevated pill positioned at `bottom: 76px`
   with touch/mouse drag handle and fast vertical flip button (`swap_vert`).
2. `top` (Top Action Bar): Fixed at the top below application headers.
3. `bubble` (Bubble Popover): Anchored dynamically above or below the selection range.

declarations.description:
Enterprise Data Grid Web Component inspired by Dojo / Dijit `dojox/grid/DataGrid` and `dgrid`.

Supported features:
- Reactive data binding via `FzlStore` (`dojo/store`) with `store.observe()`
- Static data binding via `items` array or JSON attribute
- Flexible column definitions (`columns` or Dojo `structure` alias)
- Sorting (single column asc/desc/reset)
- Live search/filtering
- Pagination bar (page navigation, page size selector: 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, All)
- Selection modes (`'none' | 'single' | 'multiple'` with checkbox column and Select All)
- CSV Export (`exportCsv()`)
- WCAG / ARIA accessibility (`role="grid"`, keyboard navigation)

Qualitative Interview Voice Transcriber Web Component.

Records voice audio from microphone (MediaRecorder & Web Audio API),
produces real-time speech-to-text transcriptions (Web Speech API),
provides rich qualitative interview tools (speaker tags, timestamps,
field notes, audio review player) and sends the package (audio + transcript +
research metadata) to the backend.
declarations.name: FzlLitInterviewTranscriber

declarations.description:
Form Container Component inspired by Dijit `dijit/form/Form`.

Scans child controls, manages collective form validation, values serialization,
dirty state checking, and submission events.
declarations.name: FzlForm

declarations.description:
Number & Currency Input Component inspired by Dijit `NumberTextBox` / `CurrencyTextBox`.

Supports prefix/suffix formatting, min/max range limits, step increments,
and mouse/touch typematic repeat acceleration on +/- stepper buttons.
declarations.name: FzlNumberInput

declarations.description:
Dropdown Select Component inspired by Dijit `Select` / `FilteringSelect`.

Supports typed options array or slotted native options, with validation,
visual state indicators, and keyboard focus integration.
declarations.name: FzlSelect

declarations.description:
Text Input Component inspired by Dijit `ValidationTextBox`.

Provides integrated label, placeholder, validation rules (required, pattern, min/max length),
visual error states, helper text, and accessible ARIA attributes.
declarations.name: FzlTextInput
